task.summary:
refactor: reorganize goods-related classes and add new specifications
- Moved GoodsVO and GoodsDetailVO to the 'spu' package. - Renamed Goods class and its related interfaces to reflect the new package structure. - Added new classes for SKU and specifications, including GoodsSku, Spec, and SpecValue. - Introduced new mappers and services for SKU and specifications management. - Updated UserContextHolder to include a method for retrieving the username. - Added XML configuration for version control settings.
